def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_futures_price = 865.0
    closing_futures_price = 877.0
    annual_collateral_rate = 0.006
    holding_period_years = 3 / 12

    # Calculate the futures price return and collateral return
    futures_return = (
        closing_futures_price - initial_futures_price
    ) / initial_futures_price
    collateral_return = annual_collateral_rate * holding_period_years
    total_return = (futures_return + collateral_return) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(total_return, 3)
